name: The Oil & Gas Producer
archetype: An upstream exploration & production company — subsurface, drilling, production

ca.what: Federal regulator of interprovincial and international pipelines and energy infrastructure — construction, operation, tolls and abandonment.
Provincial single-window licensing of wells and facilities — drilling approvals, conservation rules, closure and liability management.
Federal environmental law — methane and carbon regulations, spill reporting, and protections for air, water and wildlife.

uk.what: Licenses offshore acreage and stewards exploration, development and economic recovery on the UK Continental Shelf.
Offshore major-hazard safety regulator — accepts installation safety cases and enforces well-integrity and worker-safety law.

uk.full: Offshore Petroleum Regulator for Environment and Decommissioning
uk.what: Environmental approvals for offshore operations — emissions, discharges, oil-spill plans and decommissioning programmes.

roles.title: Board of Directors
roles.about: Elected by shareholders to govern the producer. Approves strategy, capital budgets and the annual reserves report, sets risk and HSE expectations, and holds the CEO to account. Works through its Audit, Reserves, Safety, Environment & Sustainability and Compensation committees.
